name: f117a-stealth-glider
description: Operation Nightglass — a stealth puzzle on a live Conway's Game of Life field (B3/S23).
author: Jonathan D.A. Jewell (hyperpolymath) <j.d.a.jewell@open.ac.uk>

scripts.verify: cd src && for v in verify-kernel-parity verify-los verify-level verify-corridor verify-determinism verify-witness verify-falsifier verify-renderer verify-3d-rule-search verify-beats; do bun $v.mjs; done
scripts.build: cd src && bun build.mjs && mv -f f117a-stealth-glider.html ../f117a-stealth-glider.html
